extracted.intended_audience: corporate counsel, SEC reporting officers, accountants, and corporate secretaries preparing merger proxy statements and S-4/F-4 registration statements
extracted.subtask_description: Requirements and interpretive guidance for disclosures, financial statements, and procedural filings in merger proxy statements and related Form S-4/F-4 registration statements under SEC rules. Covers what must be described about securities, transactions, parties, financial statements, incorporation by reference, and audit considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Description of securities to be authorized
rubrics_metrics.description: If securities to be authorized or issued are contemplated, state the terms of the securities (dividend/interest rates, conversion prices, voting rights, redemption prices, maturity dates, and similar matters) or state that the board will determine the terms if no further security holder authorization will be obtained.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If additional shares are of a class already outstanding, description may be omitted except for preemptive rights, if any. Where statutory preemptive rights are too indefinite/complex, an opinion of counsel as to existence/extent of such rights will suffice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transaction description and use of proceeds
rubrics_metrics.description: Briefly describe the transaction in which the securities are to be issued, including (1) the nature and approximate amount of consideration received or to be received by the registrant and (2) the approximate amount devoted to each purpose for which net proceeds have been or are to be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If impracticable to describe the transaction, state the reason, indicate the purpose of the authorization, and state whether further holder authorization will be solicited prior to issuance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure for non-public/cash-alternative issuances
rubrics_metrics.description: If securities are to be issued otherwise than in a public offering for cash, state the reasons for the proposed authorization or issuance and the general effect thereof upon the rights of existing security holders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-reference to Item 13(a)
rubrics_metrics.description: When relevant, furnish the information required by Item 13(a) of the Schedule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as cross-reference when securities-related descriptions require the financial and other information set out in Item 13(a).

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure for modification or exchange of securities
rubrics_metrics.description: If outstanding securities are to be modified, state the title and amount thereof. If securities are to be issued in exchange for outstanding securities, state the title and amount to be issued, the title and amount of outstanding securities to be exchanged, and the basis of the exchange.

rubrics_metrics.name: Material differences between outstanding and new/modified securities
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe any material differences between the outstanding securities and the modified or new securities in respect of matters that would be required in the description of securities under Item 202 of Regulation S-K.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reasons and general effect of modification/exchange
rubrics_metrics.description: State the reasons for the proposed modification or exchange and the general effect thereof upon the rights of existing security holders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of arrears or defaults
rubrics_metrics.description: Furnish a brief statement as to arrears in dividends or as to defaults in principal or interest with respect to the outstanding securities to be modified or exchanged.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also furnish such other information as appropriate to disclose adequately the nature and effect of the proposed action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outline other material features and file plan if written
rubrics_metrics.description: Outline briefly any other material features of the proposed modification or exchange. If the plan of proposed action is set forth in a written document, file copies with the Commission per §240.14a-6.

rubrics_metrics.name: Listing intent and effect of termination of listing
rubrics_metrics.description: If an existing security is presently listed and registered on a national securities exchange, state whether the registrant intends to apply for listing and registration of the new or reclassified security on such exchange or any other exchange.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the registrant does not intend to apply, state the effect of the termination of such listing and registration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial statements required by Item 13
rubrics_metrics.description: When action relates to Item 11 or 12, furnish financial statements meeting Regulation S-X requirements, including Rule 3-05 and Article 11 financial information as applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also include Item 302 supplementary financial information; Item 303 MD&A; Item 304 changes/disagreements with accountants; Item 305 quantitative and qualitative market risk disclosures; and other specified financial info.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accountants' representatives presence disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a statement as to whether representatives of the principal accountants for the current and most recently completed fiscal year (i) are expected to be present at the security holders' meeting, (ii) will have the opportunity to make a statement if they desire to do so, and (iii) are expected to be available to respond to appropriate questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Incorporation by reference rules for Item 13 information
rubrics_metrics.description: S-3 registrants and certain N-2 registrants may incorporate by reference previously-filed documents any of the information required by Item 13(a) provided paragraph (c) conditions are met; all registrants may incorporate by reference if the information is contained in an annual report or previously-filed statement delivered to security holders with the proxy and paragraph (c) conditions are met.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where registrant elected to furnish by incorporation, it may elect to update the incorporated information with subsequently filed documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conditions applicable to incorporation by reference
rubrics_metrics.description: Information may be incorporated by reference only if (1) it is not required to be included pursuant to another Item, (2) the proxy identifies on the last pages the information incorporated, and (3) the material incorporated substantially meets the requirements of the Item or portions thereof.

rubrics_metrics.name: Materiality omission instruction
rubrics_metrics.description: Any information required by paragraph (a) of Item 13 that is not material for the exercise of prudent judgment in regard to the matter to be acted upon may be omitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: information is material where matter is authorization/issuance of a material amount of senior securities, but not deemed material for authorization of common stock in many routine circumstances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signed accountant's report requirement with definitive proxy
rubrics_metrics.description: One copy of the definitive proxy statement filed with the Commission must include a manually signed copy of the accountant's report; if financial statements are incorporated by reference, a manually signed copy of the accountant's report shall be filed with the definitive proxy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signatures may be typed if the document is filed electronically on EDGAR (Rule 302 of Regulation S-T).

rubrics_metrics.name: Restriction on schedules furnished in proxy
rubrics_metrics.description: Notwithstanding Regulation S-X, no schedules other than those prepared in accordance with specified Rules of Regulation S-X need be furnished in the proxy statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References to Rules 12-15, 12-28, 12-29 (or for management investment companies, Rules 12-12 through 12-14) of Regulation S-X.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered investment company exemptions for Item 13
rubrics_metrics.description: Unless registered on a national securities exchange or otherwise required, registered investment companies need not furnish the information required by Item 13(a)(2) or (a)(3).

rubrics_metrics.name: Draft financials for preliminary proxy incorporating by reference
rubrics_metrics.description: If the registrant submits preliminary proxy material incorporating by reference financial statements required by Item 13 and the document from which they are incorporated has not been filed with or furnished to the Commission, the registrant should furnish a draft of the financial statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Form S-4/F-4/N-14 when consideration is registered securities
rubrics_metrics.description: In transactions where consideration offered to security holders consists wholly or in part of securities registered under the Securities Act, furnish the information required by Form S-4, Form F-4, or Form N-14 as applicable instead of Item 14 of the Schedule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only a Form S-4, F-4, or N-14 must be filed in accordance with §240.14a-6(j).

rubrics_metrics.name: Transactions to which Item 14 applies
rubrics_metrics.description: Item 14 applies when action is to be taken with respect to: (1) a merger or consolidation; (2) an acquisition of securities of another person; (3) an acquisition of any other going business or assets of a going business; (4) a sale or other transfer of all or any substantial part of assets; or (5) a liquidation or dissolution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required transaction information (term sheet, contacts, business, terms, approvals, reports, past contacts)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each party to the transaction furnish: summary term sheet (Item 1001 of Regulation M-A), contact information, brief description of business, terms of the transaction (Item1004(a)(2)), regulatory approvals status, reports/opinions/appraisals if materially relating to the transaction, and past contacts/transactions/negotiations as required by Regulation M-A.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial information for transactions (Article 11 / pro forma)
rubrics_metrics.description: If material, furnish financial information required by Article 11 of Regulation S-X with respect to this transaction, including pro forma financial information as appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present Article 11 information for transactions other than those being voted upon together with the pro forma information relating to the transaction being voted upon, and clearly distinguish between transactions; if pro forma info for other transactions is incorporated by reference, only present pro forma effect of this transaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acquirer and acquired company disclosure requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Acquirer must furnish the information required by Part B (Registrant Information) of Form S-4 or Form F-4 as applicable (financial statements need only be presented for the latest two fiscal years and interim periods). Acquired company must furnish the information required by Part C (Information with Respect to the Company Being Acquired) of Form S-4 or F-4.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to both SEC registrants and non-SEC registrants; see Form-specific parts for detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special rules for registered investment companies/business development companies
rubrics_metrics.description: If the acquiring company or acquired company is an investment company registered under the Investment Company Act or a business development company, provide, instead of paragraph (c) information, the information required by Items 101–105, 201, 302, 303, 304, etc., of Regulation S-K (e.g., description of business, property, legal proceedings, market price/dividends, required financial statements, MD&A).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some items (d)(6)-(d)(8) may be exempted unless registered on a national securities exchange or otherwise required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Factors determining financial statement requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether financial statements (acquirer/target) and pro forma information are required depends on factors including: which parties are voting, the form of consideration (cash, exempt securities, combination), whether the target is an SEC registrant, and the size of the target relative to the acquirer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A table and discussion summarize combinations of voting parties and consideration types to determine required financial statements and pro forma needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required target financial statements
rubrics_metrics.description: When required, target financial statements generally include three years (two for smaller reporting companies (SRCs)), interim information if applicable, and financial statements of the target's significant acquired or to-be-acquired business under S-X Rule 3-05 where required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See Question 5.3.100 for Rule 3-05 considerations and Question 5.3.90 for interim information guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required acquirer financial statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Required acquirer financial statements generally include two years of annual financial statements, interim information if applicable, and financial statements of the acquirer's significant acquired or to-be-acquired business under S-X Rule 3-05 unless previously filed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acquirer requirements may be limited to two years when incorporated under Item 14(c). See section 5.4.30 for audit considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: When acquirer financial statements are material
rubrics_metrics.description: Acquirer financial statements are considered material to an informed voting decision in circumstances such as: financing is not assured (no unconditional firm commitment), or when only acquirer shareholders are voting and financing isn't assured.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If financing is not assured, acquirer f/s for the two latest fiscal years and current interim period must be included. The SEC staff expects it to be rare for acquiring entity to conclude its financial statements are required in the merger proxy.

rubrics_metrics.name: When pro forma financial information is material
rubrics_metrics.description: Pro forma information usually is provided unless the acquisition is clearly de minimis. For a cash-only transaction where only target shareholders are voting, pro forma giving effect to the acquisition is not required because it is not relevant to target shareholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Separate financial statements for separate acquisitions (Rule 3-05)
rubrics_metrics.description: A merger proxy may require separate financial statements for separate acquisitions made by the acquiring entity or target (S-X Rule 3-05) where those acquisitions are material or otherwise required; inclusion depends on the type of consideration and materiality to the voting decision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If acquirer financial statements are required (e.g., financing not assured), then S-X Rule 3-05 statements for its acquisitions are also required. SEC staff may grant relief on a case-by-case basis if not material to financing assurance.

rubrics_metrics.name: EGC (emerging growth company) treatment for target financial statements
rubrics_metrics.description: If the target's financial statements are required in a merger proxy, the SEC staff will not object to inclusion of two years of annual financial statements (and interim) if: the merger proxy is filed after the legal acquirer's IPO but before its first Form 10-K filing deadline, and the legal acquirer is an EGC that is not a shell company (or a shell-company EGC in certain SPAC cases) and the target would be an EGC if conducting an IPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This provides an accommodation to reduce years of audited history for newly public acquirers in certain circumstances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audit requirements for financial statements in merger proxies
rubrics_metrics.description: All annual financial statements included in a merger proxy statement (for both acquiring entity and the target) must be audited.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exception: where a target is not subject to reporting under Sections 13(a) or 15(d), only the latest fiscal year need be audited if practicable; previous years need not be audited unless they were previously audited.
